name: Right eye sector colour
summary: What colour the sector in this horse's right iris is, if it has one. Mid blue is dominant - the commonest sector in the world is the blue wedge a white locus asks for, so the default is the colour that wedge already is - and the other seven each take a matched pair. Completely invisible on a horse whose sector locus is wild type, which is almost all of them.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: A mid-blue sector, if this eye has a sector at all.

phenotypes.name: Sector colour carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy of something other than mid blue, which shows nothing: every variant here is recessive to it.

phenotypes.name: Two different sector colours
phenotypes.description: Two different non-blue variants, which is a mid-blue sector. Each is recessive to the other.

phenotypes.name: Green sector
phenotypes.description: This eye's sector, wherever the sector locus put it, comes out green instead of blue. Invisible on a horse whose sector locus is wild type, which is almost all of them.
